This smartphone UI screen is from an app called "WomanLog." It is the third step out of six in a setup or configuration process. The main content of this screen is a selection menu where the user is asked to choose the first day of the week. The options available are:

- According to phone settings
- Sunday
- Monday
- Tuesday
- Wednesday
- Thursday
- Friday
- Saturday

The user can select one of these options by tapping the corresponding radio button. At the bottom of the screen, there is a "NEXT" button, which the user can tap to proceed to the next step in the setup process.
